roads.name: Old Flat Creek Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 26 curves in 5.4 miles.
The 2 miles at the north end are tamer.
From 2,510 to 2,820 ft, with 705 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.92 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Road 217
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 2.4 miles, about 8 a mile.
From 2,253 to 2,387 ft, with 319 ft of up and down along the way.
